subject: Commit resize & tempo uplift proposal
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@farside.ai>
Cc: Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@farside.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit resize & tempo uplift proposal

Hi Marta / Diego —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier this week. Per our discussion, attached is a compact proposal that balances your desire for a price hold with the anticipated peak in inference utilization driven by your Q4 product launch. Key points summarized up front: 

- Maintain current unit pricing through the 12-month renewal if Farside resizes the committed GPU-hours by +30% for the first three months (phased ramp).
- Provide a one-time anchor credit of $45k tied to a minimum 90% utilization during the first quarter after renewal (credit applied to invoice).
- Add a temporary "tempo uplift" bucket for burst capacity (up to 20% above committed) billed at a discounted overage rate for the first 90 days to smooth onboarding spikes.

I've attached the proposal PDF and a simple MAP showing monthly commit cadence and expected utilization. If this aligns, next steps are: 1) you confirm the phased ramp cadence, 2) we loop finance for contract language and invoice timing, and 3) we send the redline-ready amendment.

Attachment: [FS-Renewal-Proposal-20270707.pdf (PDF, 98KB)]
Attachment: [Farside-MAP-2027.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)]

Would you be available for a short call tomorrow to lock cadence?

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
Redwood Inference | Developers-first inference platform
From: Marta Lopez <marta@farside.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@farside.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Commit resize & tempo uplift proposal

Rachel —

Thanks for the clear summary and the files. A few quick asks from our side:

1) Can the anchor credit be split into two milestone payments tied to both onboarding completion and month-3 utilization? This helps our finance team with cashflow.
2) For the tempo uplift, can you hold the discounted overage rate for the entire first contract year if we commit to the +30% resize (we want price predictability across the ramp)?
3) We need to confirm a practical true-up cadence (monthly vs quarterly) — monthly is preferred.

Diego and I are aligned that we want to proceed quickly, but we need a smaller up-front invoice delta in month 1. If you can work with your finance team on splitting the anchor credit and a move to monthly true-up, we can sign the amendment the week of Jul 19.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Platform — Farside AI
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@farside.ai>, Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@farside.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit resize & tempo uplift proposal

Marta —

Appreciate the quick read. Looping in Ben (pricing ops) and Lauren (Revenue) to confirm whether we can: 1) split the anchor credit into two milestone credits (onboarding & month-3), and 2) extend the tempo uplift discounted overage rate for the full 12 months if the +30% commit resize is accepted.

Ben / Lauren — quick background: Farside wants to resize the commit up +30% for the initial three months (phased cadence in workbook), keep a price hold, and have a tempo uplift bucket discounted for smoothing spikes. They prefer monthly true-up and a smaller month-1 invoice impact. Proposed anchor credit is $45k applied as one credit; Farside asks to split it into two tied to onboarding completion and month-3 utilization.

Can finance/Revenue confirm feasible structuring and any implications for our invoicing calendar?

Thanks —
Rachel
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta@farside.ai>, Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@farside.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit resize & tempo uplift proposal

Folks —

Reviewed with finance and pricing. Short answers:

- Anchor credit split: acceptable. We can split the $45k into $25k at onboarding sign-off and $20k at month-3 utilization threshold (>=90%). We'll reflect both in the amendment as credits to invoices.
- Tempo uplift discount length: we can hold the discounted overage rate for up to 12 months conditional on the +30% commit resize and a signed amendment within 30 days of this email. If the amendment execution slips beyond that window, the uplift discount will be scoped to 90 days only.
- Monthly true-up: doable, but note it increases short-term billing churn; we'll keep the same true-up mechanics and report format.
- Month-1 invoice: we can defer 60% of the additional commit-related invoice for 30 days as a one-time invoicing accommodation to smooth Farside's cashflow. That will be documented in the amendment.

I'll produce a redline and a short-term invoice schedule and share a DocuSign link for the amendment once Lauren signs off on the concession language.

[Attachment stub: Invoice-Schedule-FS-20270708.xlsx (Excel, 9KB)]

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Pricing Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta@farside.ai>, Diego Ruiz <diego.ruiz@farside.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit resize & tempo uplift proposal

Ben / Rachel —

Thanks for moving quickly. I approve the split credit and the 12-month tempo uplift hold on the condition that the signed amendment arrives within 30 days and we capture a short clause that prevents retroactive application for any previous invoices. Ben: finalize the redline with the two milestone credit triggers and the one-time 60% month-1 defer. Rachel: please confirm the signing target to Marta and include the DocuSign link when you share the redline.

Marta / Diego — appreciate the collaborative approach. If that works, we'll target a Jul 19 effective signature date and produce a one-page amendment for quick legal review.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
